row.title: A rule about live systems is only true when a live reading says so: DISCOVER-1 and the tenant claims rule were false in production
row.body: The health-only gate hid the seed manifest, no seed had PUBLIC_URL bound, three tenants served no /claims.json and Replication Ledger still ran from the core copy. Repository checks were green throughout because none fetched the live surfaces. fleetcontract --live now does, for every system; the first reading ran on 2026-11-25 and named each gap.

title: A rule about live systems is only true when a live reading says so: DISCOVER-1 and the tenant claims rule were false in production
